candidates.change_summary: Replace the require overflow check with require(false) to always revert Deposit.
Replace the addition with a constant assignment, setting balance to 1 instead of adding msg.value.
Replace the addition with a subtraction, causing balance to decrease on deposit.
Delete the balance update line so Deposit never changes balances.
Replace `MinSum = _val;` with `MinSum = _val + 1;` so the stored MinSum is always off by one from the argument.
Replace `MinSum = _val;` with `MinSum = 0;` so the argument is ignored and MinSum always becomes zero.
Replace `MinSum = _val;` with `MinSum = _val * 2;` so MinSum is double the supplied argument.
Replace the revert guard condition `if(intitalized)revert();` with `if(intitalized) { /* skip revert */ }` so a second call succeeds and overwrites MinSum.
Delete the if-revert guard `if(intitalized)revert();` so SetMinSum can be called multiple times to change MinSum.
Insert `MinSum = _val - 1;` right after the original assignment so the stored MinSum becomes `_val - 1` (overwrites immediately).

Replace `require(((balances[msg.sender] + msg.value) >= balances[msg.sender]));` with `require(((balances[msg.sender] + msg.value) > balances[msg.sender]));` — wait, that’s the wrong unit. Confining edit to U001 only: Replace `if(intitalized)revert();` with `if(!intitalized)revert();` so the function reverts when NOT initialized, making it permanently unusable for its intended purpose; a subsequent call to SetMinSum after Initialized will revert, leaving MinSum at its default (0).
Change the Collect guard from >= to > for MinSum, rejecting the boundary case where balances[msg.sender] == MinSum.
Move the balance subtraction to after the external call, so reentrancy observes the old balance.
Change the balance subtraction from -= _am to += _am, so Collect increases the caller's recorded balance.
Change the if(_veri_ok) condition to if(!_veri_ok), inverting the logging/revert branch.
Log the caller's balance instead of the collected amount _am.
Delete the revert in the failed-call branch, leaving the balance update committed even when the external call fails.
Replace the balance and collection-condition guard with a tautology so Collect no longer checks MinSum or _am against the caller's balance.
Subtract the collected amount from the caller's balance before checking whether the caller is allowed to collect.
Move the external call before the balance subtraction so the callee observes the pre-withdrawal balance and can re-enter with the balance still intact.
Condition the logging call on the callee being put into an inconsistent accounting state by checking the inverse success flag.
Log the collected amount as zero instead of the actual amount while still forwarding _am to the caller.
Skip logging entirely on successful collection, changing the observable side effect on the LogFile.
